identification: Single long pale yellow straight-grained live-edge slab, one of several slabs stacked against iron in the photo, catalogued SLAB OF HUON PINE. Looks like Huon pine by colour and fine grain but no species proof from one photo; Gowans has sold dozens of near-identical slabs under the same title, some may be celery top or similar.

viewing_check: Smell and test a cut edge: Huon pine has a strong sweet oil smell and fine even grain. Check thickness (retail value needs 25 mm or more), length, width, splits and bark inclusions. Pale blond with no scent is more likely another species.
